title: Design Engineer - AI Clips Team
description:
Restream is looking for a Design Engineer to develop the user interface of our product and build new marvelous features that not only function seamlessly but are also visually appealing and have an intuitive user experience. As a Design Engineer, your primary responsibility would be to ensure that our products and features are user-friendly, well-crafted, and provide value to our users.


As a member of our team, you will be at the forefront of ideating, developing, and shipping groundbreaking experiences. We believe in small teams where each member contributes significant value.




What You'll Do

 - Craft every detail of new product features, from an idea to design to the implementation

 - Design and implement the UI/UX and business logic necessary to support new and existing features

 - Build and iterate on features to drive user engagement and conversion

 - Collaborate closely with product, marketing, and customer support teams to define your features and contribute to the overall direction of your product area

 - Give and receive code review feedback with the team

 - Maintain a pulse on emerging technologies and discover hidden opportunities in our environment



What We Look For

 - Deep understanding of the UX design process and strategy

 - Attention to detail and strive for an excellent user experience

 - Proficient with Figma or any other design and prototyping tool

 - A strong portfolio of previous design projects

 - Knowledge of JavaScript, React, and at least one of React’s major state management systems

 - Comfortable working with Figma, React, TypeScript, MobX, AWS, and continuous deployment workflow

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Self-directed, analytical, and work well in a team environment

 - Passionate about the Restream product



Back in 2015, Restream http://restream.io was founded in Ukraine. We had a burning passion for helping creators to be seen and heard. As the #1 multistreaming solution, Restream inspires over 11 million people worldwide to share their stories through live video and follow their dreams. We believe that a small but highly driven and focused team can make a lasting impact in people's lives. 



What We Offer

 - A startup environment and a flat company structure

 - Work closely with founders and team to build and grow the product

 - Opportunity to make an impact on the evolution of the product

 - Ability to create something that influences people's lives

 - Equity packages for you to truly be a part of the Restream journey

 - The tech you need to get your job done

title: Senior Product Designer (Remote in Europe)
location: Berlin, Germany · Barcelona, Spain · Lisbon, Portugal · Tallinn, Estonia
description:
About the role:

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Designer with strong product thinking who takes ownership of the customer experience, not just individual features.

You will work closely with Product and Engineering to understand customer needs, proactively identify problems and opportunities, and shape solutions that deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes.

We expect you to look beyond the immediate roadmap, challenge assumptions, and continuously advocate for improvements that make the overall product experience more intuitive, effective, and cohesive.

Your daily tasks will include:

•
Understand customers and identify opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their goals, behaviors, and challenges. Proactively identify and frame problems and opportunities through customer research, product analytics, and continuous exploration of existing experiences.

•
Shape product direction. Act as an active partner to Product and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and roadmaps. Bring customer insights, challenge assumptions, and help the team focus on problems worth solving.

•
Own end-to-end experiences. Design intuitive, effective, and cohesive customer journeys within your product area. Think beyond individual features to ensure solutions work together as part of a consistent overall product experience.

•
Drive solutions from discovery to impact. Explore and validate different approaches, make informed design decisions, and collaborate with Engineering through delivery. Define success criteria and use qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate outcomes and continuously improve the experience.

•
Champion experience improvements. Take responsibility for the quality of existing customer journeys, not only new initiatives. Identify usability gaps, friction, and inconsistencies, and advocate for improvements even when they are not yet part of the roadmap.

•
Raise the bar for design quality. Deliver high-quality design craft, contribute to our design systems, and actively explore new approaches, tools, and technologies, including AI. Share knowledge, give constructive feedback, and contribute to the Design team's continuous learning, growth, and higher standards of design practice.

Your qualifications:

•
5+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating complex problems, design decisions, and measurable impact.

•
Strong product thinking and business understanding, with the ability to proactively identify customer problems and opportunities.

•
Proven ability to own and design intuitive, cohesive end-to-end experiences across complex product journeys.

•
Strong user research and analytical skills, using qualitative and quantitative insights to inform and validate design decisions.

•
Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence product decisions.

•
Advanced proficiency with AI tools, using AI to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and problem-solving.

What we offer:

•
A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

•
An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

•
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

•
Private health insurance

•
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

•
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

•
Internal and external learning opportunities

•
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

•
Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

•
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

•
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!

FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

title: Director of Design - Maternity Cover (9 months FTC)
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

We are looking for an experienced design leader to provide maternity cover for our Director of Design from January 2027. You will cover the full remit for the duration of the leave: leading a team of product designers and a graphic design team, and making sure Design keeps moving forward on its strategic priorities during the leave.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, unblock and coach designers, and be the senior voice for Design across Product, Tech and Marketing, while stepping in on design work where it matters most.

•

Product Design: a team of product designers spread across Kpler's verticals (Commodities, Maritime, Chartering & Freight, Pricing & Trading, Platform). The focus is mainly B2B, with some B2C work, mostly on Mobile. Product Design is embedded end to end with Product, and we are accelerating on AI-assisted design to funnel non-designers' prototyping into good practice.

•

Graphic Design: a team of graphic, motion and brand designers, including freelancers, working across brand, marketing and data visualisation. We are accelerating our graphic and motion design with AI initiatives, giving the marketing team tools to speed up their work while keeping the brand consistent across the board.

Responsibilities

Leadership

• Lead and line-manage the product design team day to day: 1:1s, performance and probation management, coaching, career development.

• Provide a single point of contact for Design towards Product, Engineering and senior leadership.

• Maintain the Design coverage map so every crew knows who their designer is and who owns what.

• Support hiring in progress and onboarding of new joiners and freelancers.

Product design

• Own design quality and consistency across all Kpler products.

• Support and track delivery across the team, and act as decision maker where priorities overlap or conflict.

• Coach the team and Product on discovery, UX research and evidence-led design.

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted design workflows and guidelines, including how non-designers contribute prototypes.

Graphic design

• Set creative direction and priorities for graphic design in partnership with the Lead Graphic Designer and Marketing.

• Oversee the brand refresh, brand consistency in external materials (including AI-generated and motion content) and data visualisation standards.

• Help define and make work the operating model between Graphic Design and Marketing (service desk, briefs, sprint plans).

• Manage freelance graphic design resources.

Hands-on design

•

Step into critical product or brand work to unblock the team or cover gaps.

Must haves / Skills & Experience

• 8+ years in design, with 3+ years leading designers, ideally across product and brand/marketing design.

• Strong product design portfolio for complex B2B / data-heavy software; credible graphic design / brand sensibility.

• Experience managing a distributed, multi-disciplinary team and working with freelancers.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders in Product, Tech and Marketing and to make decisions in ambiguity.

• Fluent with Figma and design systems; comfortable with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Able to start in January 2027, with a handover period before the leave begins.

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech, data, maritime, energy or commodities.

• Experience designing a B2C mobile app.

• Experience working through a brand refresh.

• Accessibility knowledge (WCAG / VPAT).

title: Product Design Intern (USA)
location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We’re looking for curious, collaborative Product Design interns to help shape products and experiences that are useful, inspiring, and meaningful for our Pinners. Partnering with mentors and teammates across product, design, engineering, data science, research, and marketing, you’ll help define problems, evaluate opportunities, and drive execution on real product work. You’ll gain hands-on experience balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints—while learning how AI-first thinking and AI-powered tools can accelerate product development from idea to launch.

What you’ll do:

• Take ownership over the completion and quality of your tasks and project while incorporating guidance from your mentor, manager, and peers

• Support product work end-to-end, from problem definition and opportunity sizing through execution, launch, and learning

• Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, data science, research, and other teams to build the future of Pinterest

• Leverage data, user insights, and product judgment to help identify customer needs and inform product decisions

• Contribute to product specs, prioritization, experimentation, and go-to-market planning for scoped initiatives

• Leverage AI tools to optimize your workflow —whether brainstorming, synthesizing insights, drafting product docs, or accelerating execution

• Communicate new ideas and opinions with candor as you grow both professionally and personally through learning and development opportunities

What we’re looking for:

• This position requires current enrollment in a school or education program in which the individual is working towards a Bachelor’s degree in design, engineering, or a related field

• Obtain Bachelor’s or Master's degree by 2028

• Previous internship, academic, or leadership experience in product management, software, design, analytics, consulting, entrepreneurship, or a related area

• Demonstrated interest in building great products and solving user problems

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and levels

• Has a learner and builder mindset: able to quickly onboard to emerging AI tools and apply them appropriately throughout the product development process with a focus on decision quality, craft, and efficiency

• Familiarity using AI as a learning and productivity tool to accelerate product work while exercising strong judgment around accuracy, privacy, security, and when to ask for help

We offer 2 internship start dates:

• May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027

• June 21, 2027 - September 10, 2027

In-Office Requirement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• For this role, some interns will work in a hybrid model (commutable distance to one of our offices, with in-person collaboration approximately 1–2 times per week), and some will work fully remote within approved locations. Specific location and work style (hybrid or remote) will be confirmed during the interview and offer process.

• Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

description:
Join the AI revolution. We’re building an all-in-one AI platform to help teams do their best work and automate every routine task you can think of. We’re looking for problem-solvers to turn powerful AI into an easy, no-code tool for teams everywhere.

Main Responsibilities

• Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering to navigate ambiguity and shape solutions. Take initiative and help define what needs to be done.

• Lead problem discovery, not just execute solution design.

• Use continuous, lightweight discoveries, run rapid experiments, build prototypes, and validate design decisions before building.

• Talk to users regularly through low-effort, AI-assisted research activities. Focus on what can be done with available resources and time.

• Design AI-native experiences that create trust while accounting for AI hallucinations, latency, and model limitations.

• Think system-first and ensure the product ecosystem feels coherent and consistent.

• Balance speed and quality while shipping imperfect MVPs in small increments, continuously improving with user feedback while maintaining the long-term product vision.

• Balance several tasks at once, prioritize activities effectively, and ensure deadlines and quality standards are met.

• Share feedback, improve design patterns, and help scale the overall product experience.

Core Requirements

• Proven startup experience with an ability to adapt and drop rigid processes.

• Experience designing AI-powered or complex systems, demonstrating a systems-thinking approach over isolated feature design.

• Show clear communication with a proficiency in explaining trade-offs, constraints, and reasoning behind design decisions.

• Capability to identify key assumptions in a product idea and validate them quickly through experiments, prototypes, or user insights.

• Experience defining success metrics and using real product data to guide design iteration.

• Hands-on experience with user research methods, analytics, usability testing, user interviews, or related UX research techniques.

• Ability to drive the design process independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

• Focus on both user problems and organizational outcomes, rather than just UI deliverables.

• Basic technical understanding and familiarity with modern web technologies.

• Highly curious about AI and how UX can make those systems understandable and trustworthy.

Bonus Points

• Active utilization of AI tools to accelerate and improve your own design process.

• NOTE: We look forward to your portfolio, particularly highlighting projects focused on complex SaaS products, multi-step user workflows and mobile applications. Case studies showcasing end-to-end product design work are highly appreciated.

Salary Range

• Team spirit. Team buildings and parties with games, shows, tastings, food coupons, gifts, and it’s on us.

• More free time. Stay with us and additional vacation days will be added to your calendar.

• Additional paid leave. Additional days are covered by us in cases of illness or special occasions.

• Flexibility. Flexible working time arrangement.

description:
Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.

I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.

Background & reason for hiring

Modash helps brands scale creator partnerships on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Brands pay creators in lots of different ways: free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions. Today those are separate flows rather than one coherent experience.

This role is about building one payment experience that handles all of them, on both sides:

• Brand side - setting up the deal and paying for it

• Creator side - getting paid

You own the entire workflow end to end. The role combines design and product management in one person: you decide what to build and why, and then you design how it works.

This is what you'll own:

The payments experience

Free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions, for brands and creators alike, from setting up the deal to the creator getting paid. You work on prototypes and concepts for future iterations, design them, collect feedback and get the requirements ready for engineering.

Running development cycles

• Prepping user stories and explaining them to the engineers

• Doing the QA once the work is ready

• Giving and receiving feedback in retros

• Deciding when it's good enough to get into customers' hands - it's your product

The customer voice and the story

• Talking with customers about their pains and needs around paying creators, gifting products and running affiliate programs

• Keeping everyone in the company up to date on your roadmap, new releases and plans for the next sprints

• Working closely with product marketing so your product stands out and customers understand what's new

• Tracking your impact using customer feedback and north star metrics

Your first months in Modash will bring

• Onboarding with the product and Creator teams on how brands and creators use Modash today

• Customer calls with brands and creators, plus time in Fullstory and Amplitude to see where the payment flows break down

• Joining sprint planning with the engineering team and getting to know the backlog

Team structure

You'll report to me (Head of Product) and work closely with a dedicated engineering team lead Besnik. You'll also join a group of talented designer/PMs Renata, Maksym & Heidi who own other parts of our B2B SaaS product, and you'll work with them on product ideas, the shared design system and synced roadmaps.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

• Experience as both a product designer & product manager or in a hybrid PM/design role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

• You've written great user stories and communicated your designs clearly to developers

• You've prioritized work with a bigger goal in mind and built a roadmap yourself. You can explain why some things came first and others didn't make the cut.

• You've worked with a design system to keep the experience coherent

• Extreme attention to detail. You notice the wrong spacing, the unclear label and the missing edge case, and you don't ship sloppy work.

• Get-it-done attitude. We all run into roadblocks every day. We're looking for someone who finds solutions, motivates themselves and keeps getting things done.

• You're used to, and actually enjoy, a fast pace and constant change in a growing company

• You aspire to be great. We're not shooting for mediocrity here.

• Interest in the creator economy. Our mission is to help creators get paid. You don't need to live and breathe the creator world, but we'd like your values to align with ours.

• You're fluent in English. Our team is spread across many countries, and we work together in English every day.

Nice to haves:

• UX work on affiliate, marketplace or payments products

• Strong instincts in research or analytics (you don't need to be an expert in both)

• Experience with our tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, Amplitude and Fullstory

If you meet most but not all of these, don't let that stop you from applying. We're not looking for a finished product, and we'd be happy to grow with you.

Benefits

What we're offering

• Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.

• Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 65,000€ - 85,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.

• Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.

• Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you're happy and well rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.

• Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we'll cover it.

• Ownership 💡 You're the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.

• Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

•

Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

•

Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

•

The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

•

Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

•

A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

•

A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

•

7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

•

An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

•

Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

•

Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

•

Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

•

Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

•

Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

•

Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

•

Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

•

Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

MapTiler is moving toward becoming an AI-accelerated company, and design is a part of that change. We are looking for a Head of Design to lead the craft and the design practice across our products and customer experience, and help to define the new setup and processes for how designers should work. This is a completely new role at MapTiler!

What you will do

• Own the design roadmap, which runs in parallel to the product and marketing roadmaps.

• Make company-wide design decisions, set standards and quality, and speak up when they are not met.

What we expect from you

• At least 8 years of experience in UX, UI, or product design, including 3+ years in a design leadership role.

• Experience building and leading a design team, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• The ability to explain design decisions with concrete arguments based on qualitative and quantitative user research.

• The ability to influence and negotiate at the executive level.

• An understanding that good design serves a deeper purpose than looking good.

• A strong drive for self-improvement, learning, sharing knowledge, and trying new approaches.

Nice to have

• Knowledge of the GIS or map industry.

• Experience with Agile methodology.

• A friendly, connected team and regular team-building events across Europe.

About MapTiler

We make maps easy so that everyone can understand the world better. Our platform powers everything from global weather forecasting and humanitarian crisis management to flight trackers and the Swiss railways. Our maps are viewed by hundreds of millions of people worldwide every month.
We are deeply rooted in the developer and open-source communities. Since our users and customers are primarily developers, engineers, and geo-experts, we don't only do traditional account management, we also build technical partnerships.

title: Lead Product Designer | Platform Engineering
description:
Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy - and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.

What we do

RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.

We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we are looking for a Lead Product Designer to own the user experience of core platform capabilities end to end, embedded directly with the teams that build them.

You are a Lead-level designer with excellent design judgement and the skills to understand platform users’ needs and product goals. You apply agentic engineering workflows to ship features into production and contribute directly to delivering customer value. This is a hands-on role where you shape the scope of the work and are accountable for high-quality design outcomes.

The role requires understanding both the technical infrastructure behind applications and the use cases they aim to solve. Being part of the platform department calls for systemic thinking and solutions that scale to broader use cases and needs.

This role reports into Platform Engineering and is part of the Design Excellence community of 15+ designers across RELEX.

What we need you to do and be

Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.

• Own the user experience of Core Platform application's configuration end to end, embedded in the team that builds it

• Work daily with engineers: talk an idea through, review the first build, and bring it up to production quality, and prototype new features with agentic tools

• Contribute directly to code, combining design judgment with AI-assisted development to ship to production

• Work with the internal builders who use the platform to shape the team’s direction and keep the UI consistent with the main product

• Cover design quality for both UX and UI for the team, so craft and quality are yours to set and keep

What you’ll bring to the table

Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don’t make sense. We stop doing what doesn’t add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.

• Strong product design thinking and execution: have a clear approach on identifying what to build, with good quality

• Systems thinking and information architecture: ability to learn a complex platform quickly

• Research skills in technical domains: experience working with technical, business-first internal users

• Hands-on contribution to shipped solutions: you contribute to working front-end code and are comfortable with agentic and AI-assisted development

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure in a fast-moving environment

• Interest in building tools for the people who build, and in AI-assisted development

• Strong collaboration with engineering, product and design, and the ability to challenge assumptions with evidence

• Fast learning and a proactive, self-managing way of working

• Fluent in written and spoken English

As a bonus

• Experience in AI-assisted workflows

• Experience with plugins, extensions or platform tooling

• Have worked on platform teams or building applications to enables others to build

What we offer in return

You’ll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.

• An international career and learning opportunities in a fast-growing, financially robust software company

• Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness and everyday life, and annual leave

• A diverse, inclusive and supportive work culture, with ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies

• Work that reduces waste and improves sustainability

• Real ownership of an area end to end, close to the team that builds it. You decide how it looks, works and ships.

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other.

Please note that to be considered for this position, you must be fluent in English, be based in Finland and hold a valid work permit for your country of residence. We’re excited to connect with applicants who meet these criteria and share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what’s next for the product, the planet, and the people.

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume and portfolio through the application form as soon as possible.

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

• Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.

• Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.

• Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.

• Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.

• Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.

• Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.

• Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.

• Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

Who You Are

• You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design.

• You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery.

• You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production.

• You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems.

• You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences.

• You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most.

• You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems.

• You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling.

• You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be

• This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Design Systems Engineer to be one of the few engineers building the components that every Ramp product team uses — the person who makes our design system real in code. You’ll work in close partnership with our design systems lead and designers: they decide what the rules are, and you decide how to enforce them. Sometimes that’s a component that won’t allow a bad pattern. Sometimes it’s a codebase move that makes the right path the easy one. Sometimes it’s automation that catches drift before it spreads.

With AI agents now writing much of the UI, this role is also at the frontier of a changing craft. You’ll help decide what the system has to guarantee when humans and agents are both building on top of it — because agents don’t settle for the happy path, and the system needs to hold up either way.

Having worked as a designer (or deeply alongside one), you understand the design-eng collaboration challenges firsthand. You’re driven to improve it because you’ve lived with the pain points. You excel in UI and accessible design, prefer working directly in-browser, and get excited about emerging CSS properties.

This is an IC role on a small team, which means you’ll have real say in architecture, API design, and the tradeoffs that shape how Ramp builds — foundational, detail-obsessed frontend work with an outsized impact on every screen we ship.


What You’ll Do

 - Build and evolve the components and APIs that every product team at Ramp depends on

 - Make the enforcement call: when to encode a rule in the component itself, when to leave it to guidance, and when to invest in automation that catches drift

 - Partner with our design systems lead and designers to turn UX patterns and principles into working, consistent components

 - Shape the system so it holds up when both engineers and AI agents are building on it

 - Contribute to internal tooling and infrastructure that keeps velocity high without sacrificing quality

 - Champion the user experience and accessibility of our products, and keep the quality bar high

 - Help designers and engineers across Ramp ship faster with elegant, consistent component APIs and a focus on developer experience

 - Advocate for users by continuously iterating on our core products and experiences

 - Participate in day-to-day team rituals like design crit, story creation, and weekly stand-ups

 - Help us hire and grow the team to bring more craft and more perspectives to the work
   

What You Need

 - Tech/startup or digital product agency experience, or equivalent

 - A strong frontend engineer who could pass any engineering loop at Ramp — real hands-on skill, not just prompting AI to write code

 - Experience building design system components and APIs, not only consuming them

 - Excellent front-end development skills in semantic HTML, CSS (up to date on latest features) and JavaScript (and frameworks, pref. React)

 - Ability to drive implementation end to end, with sound UX and system design sense

 - Strong understanding of Product Design software (pref. Figma) and visual/interaction design principles

 - Strong organizational skills and a love for documentation

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to push back with reasons — e.g., when encoding a rule in a component would slow everyone down

 - Care for the details: motion, states, accessibility, and the small decisions that make a system feel coherent
   

Nice to Haves

 - Design systems experience from before AI tooling took off

 - Ability to articulate complex concepts to technical and non-technical peers

 - Solid understanding of accessibility development practices




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

title: Lead Economy and Engagement Designer - ARC Raiders
description:
As a Lead Economy and Engagement Designer at Embark, you will be responsible for designing and implementing systems and mechanics that are deep and interesting for our players to engage with and retain them, short, medium and long term, as well as sustainable and player-friendly monetization features and models, that provide real value to our players, in a fair way.

You will join the team on ARC Raiders and collaborate closely with the directors of the project, in refining concepts and ideas into tangible designs, prototypes and features, as well as Production leadership helping in articulating and establishing estimates, project scope and timelines. You will share your insights and knowledge in shaping relevant performance indicators, as well as validation methods using telemetry data and simulations.

As a senior member of the design team we would like you to act as a coach and mentor to some of the other designers on the project, and possibly take on direct managerial responsibilities, if relevant and suitable. Inspiring and helping more junior designers with design methodology, documentation practices, etc.

You will also own and spearhead game features directly, and work hands-on in cross disciplinary teams while implementing features and tools for running a successful and smooth live service game, including community events and other types of events.

Example of responsibilities

•
Design, implementation and evaluation of our monetization strategy including quantitative and qualitative analysis, as well as any available automation and simulation strategies.

•
Understanding player motivations and how they relate to our game loops, especially in terms of delivering a fun gameplay experience with engagement systems.

•
Responsible for in-game virtual store including recommendations and contributions towards catalog and pricing strategy for micro-transactions.

•
Joint optimization with marketing, acquisition and crm teams for the entire user journey.

•
Be a key stakeholder in game frontend presentation and flow for engagement and game economy features.

•
Design and collaborate on metagame, progression and economy systems for long term player retention and engagement.

•
Analyze the impact of changes in the game, identify opportunities that will have a positive impact on monetization and engagement in development and post launch.

•
Help define key performance indicators (KPIs) related to monetization, analyze KPI reports and share information with the team and stakeholders to identify and predict trends.

•
Monitor trends on monetization in order to identify best practices, achieve optimal results and innovation.

We would love if you have

•
A creative and curious mind.

•
5+ years or more experience in equivalent roles.

•
An understanding of acquisition, retention and monetization concepts.

•
Understanding of AAA gameplay and game design, including player psychology, UX design, gameplay design.

•
Proficiency with the Unreal Engine and experience with Blueprints and scripting.

•
Ability to design and continuously improve the optimization process of any given game.

•
Experience with experimental design and/or AB Testing for data driven designs.

•
Experience of coaching more junior members of the team.

•
Strong communication skills and the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders

•
Professional English communication skills.

This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Senior UI Artist
location: Remote (Albania, Andorra, Austria, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Faroe Islands, Finland, France, Germany, Gibraltar, Greece, Guernsey, Holy See (Vatican City State), Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Isle of Man, Italy, Jersey, Kosovo, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, San Marino, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Svalbard and Jan Mayen, Sweden, Switzerland, Ukraine, United Kingdom, Åland Islands)
description:
Maintain artistic direction and quality

• Produce high quality UI art suitable technically and artistically with the project's universe and visual direction.

• Craft static and dynamic user interfaces that effectively convey information and actions, while delivering an enjoyable and engaging user experience.

Production/deadline

• Transforming wireframes into polished assets within specifications and maintaining workflow pipelines within given deadlines.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation outlining the UI's visual language, covering aspects such as color theory, typography, iconography, visual hierarchy, and motion design, from initial concept to implementation and ongoing iteration.

• Bug Fixing and describing R&D case studies in the knowledge base.

Feedback

• Participate in reviews, adapt to, and implement feedback from leads and peers in a professional manner.

• Provide feedback and improvement to visual quality.

Collaboration/Communication

• Knowledge sharing.

• Collaborate closely with UX, Game Design, Production, and other key stakeholders to plan, prioritize, and refine the visual aesthetics of new and existing UI Art.

• Develop and curate project-specific style guides and high-fidelity asset libraries, ensuring a consistent user experience, scalability, and enhanced productivity and collaboration with other teams through shared resources.

• Collaborate in R&D initiatives, to explore new techniques and implement improvements to pipelines and workflows.

• Occasionally support leads and HR collaboration in recruitment efforts.

• Occasionally support new hires onboard process.

• 5+ years in AAA console/PC game development including 3+ year in Unreal Engine.

• A strong portfolio showcasing UI design expertise.

• A solid understanding of traditional art skills along with foundational design competencies (shape, form, texture, value and color, typography and layout).

• A solid grasp of UI/UX conventions and principles.

• Proficient in implementing accessibility best practices encompassing color, scale, typography, and other visual design elements.

• Capable of envisioning, presenting, and executing high-level concepts within tight deadlines.

• Extensive expertise in Figma and other wireframing and prototyping tools.

• Excellent knowledge of industry-standard software packages for modeling, high-poly sculpting (Maya, Max, ZBrush, Photoshop, or their equivalents).

• Proficiency in handling multi-SKU, multi-resolution projects on both console and PC platforms.

• Demonstrates a deep understanding of UI design in games across various genres and platforms.

• Adaptive.

• Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new styles, techniques and workflows with basic guidance.

• Ability to collaborate with department leads, and different departments to solve artistic and technical challenges.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Good mentoring skills.

• Self-motivation.

Nice to have

• Art education, graphic design and drawing skills.

• Experience with Unreal Engine 5.

What we offer

• Private medical healthcare including dental treatment for PCF members and their families (Signal Iduna).

• MultiSport card for you and your family members or friends.

• Free library with a wide range of games and books you have unlimited access to.

• In-company Polish and English language classes.

• Fresh fruit, snacks, and beverages for everyone in the office.

• Flexible working hours.

• Free virtual health and mental wellbeing sessions are included in the plan for members and their dependents.

• Personal development opportunities and ability to work in a global environment.

• Work in a creative team with people full of passion for what they do.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse work culture. PCF is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

*The role is open to candidates only from the game industry who are based in Europe.

People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. As one of the most experienced Unreal Engine studios in the industry, we continue to expand on our expertise and push the boundaries of what’s possible in game development.

Our creative teams are currently working on several exciting titles: Gears of War: E-Day developed in collaboration with Microsoft; Project Echo for KRAFTON; and Lost Rift, an original IP we are developing in-house under our self-publishing model. We are also exploring new platforms and experiences with VR and other unannounced projects.

With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.
